answer: Run mirror tests: each epoch the network pairs keys at random and asks every key to predict, in secret, what its partner will answer to an odd open question, like the moral of a made-up fable. Strangers guess their partner poorly, but keys driven by one operator share prompts and memory and predict each other almost perfectly. A key whose predictions of certain peers are far above the network baseline lights a beacon on that pair, and both rewards pause until an outside auditor checks them.
